title: add-benchmark-lab-adaptive-batching-reporting-pipeline
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Add adaptive-batching reporting pipeline, representative workload runners, and updated profiling baselines for benchmark-lab. Motivation: we need end-to-end visibility into how adaptive batching policies affect tail latency and throughput across representative workloads (chat, summarization, embeddings). This PR introduces a new reporting DAG that aggregates per-run adaptive-batching telemetry, stores histograms and percentiles, and emits combined CSV/Parquet reports for downstream dashboards. Changes include: new adaptive-batching runner harness (benchmarks/runners/adaptive_batching_runner.py), updated profiling baselines for quantized and FP16 variants, telemetry exporters for per-batch metrics (batch_size, batch_wait_ms, kv_cache_hit_rate), and CI integration to validate reporting outputs. Checklist: - [x] Implement runner harness and tests - [x] Add reporting DAG and aggregation logic - [x] Add Prometheus/telemetry exporters and unit tests - [x] Update profiling baselines and add sample datasets - [x] Add e2e smoke test in CI - [x] Documentation notes in benchmark-lab/README.md. Related: ENG-3123 (adaptive batching rollout), ENG-3198 (reporting/dashboard requirements).
